kitchens.title: Kitchen organisations
kitchens.subtitle: Every kitchen on the platform — who runs it, what it is selling, and whether it may trade.
kitchens.emptyBody: Clear the search or the status filter to see the rest of the platform.
kitchens.errorTitle: The kitchen list could not be loaded

detail.errorTitle: This kitchen could not be loaded
detail.notFound: No kitchen with that identifier exists.

owners.title: Owners
owners.subtitle: People who hold the owner role in this kitchen. Ending a membership takes effect immediately.
owners.emptyBody: Invite one below. Until somebody accepts, nobody can open this kitchen's workspace.
owners.revokeBody: {{name}} will lose access to {{kitchen}} immediately. The record that they were an owner is kept.
owners.revokeLastWarning: This is the only owner. Ending it leaves the kitchen with nobody who can run it.
owners.revokedLast: Membership ended. This kitchen now has no owner.

invite.title: Invite an owner
invite.subtitle: They receive an email with a link. Accepting it requires signing in with the same address.
invite.nameHint: Used in the greeting only — never stored.
invite.messageHint: A line from you, shown in the invitation email.
invite.messagePlaceholder: e.g. Your kitchen is ready for you
invite.sent: Invitation sent to {{email}}. It expires on {{date}}.
invite.sentNotMailed: The invitation was created for {{email}}, but the email could not be sent. Send it again to try once more.
invite.supersedes: Inviting the same address again replaces any invitation still outstanding.

lifecycle.suspendBody: This kitchen disappears from the marketplace, cannot be quoted or ordered from, and cannot publish anything. Its staff keep read access to their workspace.
lifecycle.suspendReasonHint: Optional. Shown to whoever reviews this later.
lifecycle.reactivateBody: The kitchen returns to the marketplace and can publish and sell again. The suspension note is cleared.
lifecycle.closedNote: A closed organisation was offboarded. It cannot be reactivated.

create.title: Add a kitchen
create.subtitle: Creates the organisation, its first branch and a web sales channel. The catalogue starts empty and the workspace works immediately.
create.slugHint: Lowercase words joined by hyphens. It appears in marketplace links and cannot be changed later.
create.branchNameHint: The kitchen's main site. More can be added from its own workspace.
create.created: {{name}} is ready. Invite an owner to hand it over.

b2b.title: B2B applications
b2b.subtitle: Companies asking to buy wholesale — review them, agree terms with a kitchen, and open their account.
b2b.emptyBody: No application matches this tab and search.
b2b.emptyQueueBody: No application is waiting to be picked up.

detail.errorTitle: This application could not be loaded
detail.duplicatesTitle_one: {{count}} other application has the same registration or tax number
detail.duplicatesTitle_other: {{count}} other applications have the same registration or tax number
detail.duplicatesBody: Check whether this company has applied before. Nothing is done about it automatically.
detail.conflictBody: Reload to see the latest version, then try again.

claim.title: Waiting to be picked up
claim.body: Claim it so other reviewers know you are working on it.

decide.title: Your decision
decide.body: Check the company and its documents, then approve, ask for more, or decline.

waiting_applicant.title: Waiting for the applicant
waiting_applicant.body: They have been asked for more information. The application comes back to the queue when they send it.

draft_agreement.title: Agree the terms
draft_agreement.body: Draft the trading agreement: which kitchen's negotiated price list the company buys at, and on what payment terms.

send_agreement.title: Send the agreement
send_agreement.body: The draft is not visible to the applicant yet. Send it when the terms are right — they are emailed a link to sign.

waiting_signature.title: Waiting for the signature
waiting_signature.body: The applicant has been sent the agreement. Revise it if the terms need to change before they sign.

provision.title: Open the account
provision.body: The agreement is signed. Opening the account creates the company, makes the applicant its owner and emails the other contacts.

provisioned.title: Account open
provisioned.body: The company can order. Contacts who have not accepted their invitation can be sent a fresh link below.

closed.title: Closed
closed.body: This application was declined or withdrawn. Nothing more can be done with it.

toast.claimed: Claimed. It is yours to review.
toast.sent: Agreement sent. The applicant has been emailed a link to sign.
toast.provisioned_one: {{company}} is open, and {{count}} invitation was emailed.
toast.provisioned_other: {{company}} is open, and {{count}} invitations were emailed.

agreement.title: Agreement
agreement.none: No agreement has been drafted yet.
agreement.sendBody: The applicant is emailed a link to read and sign it. After this, changing the terms means revising it into a new version.
agreement.reviseBody: The version waiting for signature is withdrawn and kept on record, and a new draft opens with the same terms for you to change.

invitations.title: Invitations
invitations.body: The applicant owns the account. Everybody else named on the application was emailed an invitation.
invitations.resent: A new invitation was emailed to {{email}}.

documents.mismatch: File type differs from what was declared
documents.rejectBody: The applicant sees the reason and can upload a replacement.

request.title: Request more information
request.body: The applicant can edit only the sections you name. Name none to ask for documents.
request.messageHint: The applicant reads this exactly as written.

approve.title: Approve this application?
approve.body: Approval records the decision. The account is opened later, once the agreement is signed.
approve.documentsWarning_one: {{count}} required document is missing or not accepted yet.
approve.documentsWarning_other: {{count}} required documents are missing or not accepted yet.
approve.applicantMessageHint: Optional. Emailed to the applicant with the approval.

decline.title: Decline this application?
decline.body: This cannot be undone. The applicant is told why.
decline.applicantMessageHint: Required. Say what was wrong so the applicant can act on it.

provision.title: Open the account for {{company}}?
provision.body: This cannot be undone. It creates:
provision.invitations: Emailed invitations for everybody else named on the application

editor.intro: The applicant sees nothing until you send it.
editor.title: Title
editor.priceListHint: A kitchen's negotiated price list. Choosing it chooses who the company buys from and in which currency.
editor.noListsTitle: No kitchen has a negotiated price list yet
editor.noListsBody: A kitchen creates one in Wholesale setup. Each list prices exactly one company.
editor.summaryHint: Shown to the signatory above the terms.
editor.notANumber: Enter a number, zero or more.
